text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Looking at how things went today... It 
feels like Air Shakur might make an 
appearance next year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She feels like she's on a completely 
different level from the other girls! 
Though somehow, she doesn't really seem 
like the main character type.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if anyone else like a "rival" 
will show up...—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Let's check it out.

"Without even wiping her sweat, Air Shakur 
typed today's results into Parcae. 
Watching her with bated breath..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Is this... real...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That 7 cm... is actually shrinking.

Air Shakur has been silent ever since. 
You'd think she'd be a bit happier about 
this, but...

From her perspective, numbers she thought 
would never budge have suddenly changed. 
She might be feeling more bewildered than 
anything.
choice_data_list: I wonder if destiny has changed?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No. It just means that the possibility has 
now been born.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However, until now, even that possibility 
was nonexistent... It was an 
insurmountable wall with no way to break 
through.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"It moved, even if only by a millimeter. 
In that case, seriously..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"No... No, no. Don't go putting your faith 
in possibilities until things are set in 
stone."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
My thinking is getting dull, biased. I 
need to view this as an objective fact.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"My body ain't anywhere near the 
theoretical peak needed to win the Satsuki 
Sho yet."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There ain't much time left, but she's 
making steady progress. If she keeps 
sticking to the menu like this...
choice_data_list: We'll win the Satsuki Sho, and then—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Finally.
